// Go oracle generator for the ignored Rust test `thinking_oracle_file_matches_go`.
// Not compiled here. To use: copy a CLIProxyAPI checkout, save this file as
// internal/thinking/zz_gen_test.go (package thinking_test), and run
//   go test ./internal/thinking/ -run TestZZGen -count=1
// It writes /tmp/oracle_wide.jsonl (about 247k records: ApplyThinking, ApplyThinkingWithModelInfo*,
// summary extract/apply, effort labels, strip, ValidateConfig). Then, in this repo:
//   THINKING_ORACLE=/tmp/oracle_wide.jsonl cargo test -p cpa-core thinking_oracle -- --ignored

func ts(min, max int, zero, dyn bool, levels ...string) *registry.ThinkingSupport {
	return &registry.ThinkingSupport{Min: min, Max: max, ZeroAllowed: zero, DynamicAllowed: dyn, Levels: levels}
}

func matrixModels() []*registry.ModelInfo {
	return []*registry.ModelInfo{
		{ID: "level-model", Type: "openai", Thinking: ts(0, 0, false, false, "minimal", "low", "medium", "high")},
		{ID: "level-subset-model", Type: "gemini", Thinking: ts(0, 0, false, false, "low", "high")},
		{ID: "gemini-budget-model", Type: "gemini", Thinking: ts(128, 20000, false, true)},
		{ID: "gemini-mixed-model", Type: "gemini", Thinking: ts(128, 32768, false, true, "low", "high")},
		{ID: "gemini-toggle-mixed-model", Type: "gemini", Thinking: ts(128, 32768, true, true, "low", "high")},
		{ID: "claude-budget-model", Type: "claude", Thinking: ts(1024, 128000, true, false)},
		{ID: "claude-opus-4-6-model", Type: "claude", MaxCompletionTokens: 128000, Thinking: ts(1024, 128000, true, false, "low", "medium", "high", "max")},
		{ID: "claude-sonnet-4-6-model", Type: "claude", MaxCompletionTokens: 64000, Thinking: ts(1024, 128000, true, false, "low", "medium", "high")},
		{ID: "antigravity-budget-model", Type: "antigravity", Thinking: ts(128, 20000, true, true)},
		{ID: "kimi-toggle-thinking-model", Type: "kimi", Thinking: ts(0, 0, true, false, "low", "medium", "high")},
		{ID: "kimi-tiered-thinking-model", Type: "kimi", Thinking: ts(0, 0, false, false, "low", "medium", "high")},
		{ID: "xai-level-model", Type: "xai", Thinking: ts(0, 0, true, false, "none", "low", "medium", "high")},
		{ID: "no-thinking-model", Type: "openai"},
		{ID: "user-defined-model", Type: "openai", UserDefined: true},
	}
}

}

var wideSuffixes = []string{"", "", "", "(none)", "(auto)", "(-1)", "(0)", "(512)", "(1024)", "(8192)", "(24576)", "(64000)", "(minimal)", "(low)", "(medium)", "(high)", "(xhigh)", "(max)", "(HIGH)", "(bogus)", "()", "(08192)"}
var wideFrom = []string{"openai", "openai-response", "claude", "gemini", "codex", "antigravity", "interactions", "", "kimi"}
var wideTo = []string{"gemini", "claude", "openai", "codex", "openai-response", "antigravity", "kimi", "kimi-ai", "xai", "interactions", "bogus", " Claude "}

func pick(n int, parts ...string) int {
	h := fnv.New64a()
	for _, p := range parts {
		h.Write([]byte(p))
		h.Write([]byte{0})
	}
	return int(h.Sum64() % uint64(n))
}

type rec map[string]any

func TestZZGen(t *testing.T) {
	reg := registry.GetGlobalRegistry()
	reg.RegisterClient("zz-gen", "test", matrixModels())
	defer reg.UnregisterClient("zz-gen")

	f, err := os.Create("/tmp/oracle_wide.jsonl")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer f.Close()
	w := bufio.NewWriterSize(f, 1<<20)
	defer w.Flush()
	emit := func(r rec) {
		b, _ := json.Marshal(r)
		w.Write(b)
		w.WriteByte('\n')
	}

	// kind=apply: registry lookup path.
	n := 0
	for _, model := range wideModels {
		for _, to := range wideTo {
			for bi, body := range wideBodies {
				key := fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%d", model, to, bi)
				for variant := 0; variant < 2; variant++ {
					from := wideFrom[pick(len(wideFrom), key, "from", fmt.Sprint(variant))]
					suffix := ""
					if variant == 1 {
						suffix = wideSuffixes[pick(len(wideSuffixes), key, "suffix")]
					}
					providerKey := to
					if pick(5, key, "pk") == 0 {
						providerKey = "claude"
					}
					m := model + suffix
					out, err := thinking.ApplyThinking([]byte(body), m, from, to, providerKey)
					r := rec{"kind": "apply", "model": m, "from": from, "to": to, "providerKey": providerKey, "input": body, "output": string(out), "err": err != nil}
					if err != nil {
						r["errMsg"] = err.Error()
						if te, ok := err.(*thinking.ThinkingError); ok {
							r["errCode"] = string(te.Code)
						}
					}
					emit(r)
					n++
				}
			}
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("apply records", n)

	// kind=applyInfo: exact model info path with source bodies.
	type spec struct {
		ID           string
		Type         string
		HasThinking  bool
		Min, Max     int
		Zero, Dyn    bool
		Levels       []string
		MaxCompl     int
		CfgUpdate    bool
		UserDefined  bool
	}
	specs := []spec{
		{ID: "s-level", Type: "openai", HasThinking: true, Levels: []string{"low", "medium", "high"}},
		{ID: "s-level-xmax", Type: "openai", HasThinking: true, Levels: []string{"high", "max"}},
		{ID: "s-claude-adaptive", Type: "claude", HasThinking: true, Min: 1024, Max: 128000, Zero: true, Levels: []string{"low", "medium", "high", "max"}, MaxCompl: 64000},
		{ID: "s-claude-levels-only", Type: "claude", HasThinking: true, Levels: []string{"high"}},
		{ID: "s-claude-manual", Type: "claude", HasThinking: true, Min: 1024, Max: 16000, MaxCompl: 32000},
		{ID: "s-gemini-hybrid", Type: "gemini", HasThinking: true, Min: 128, Max: 32768, Dyn: true, Levels: []string{"low", "high"}},
		{ID: "s-gemini-budget", Type: "gemini", HasThinking: true, Min: 128, Max: 20000, Zero: true, Dyn: true},
		{ID: "s-antigravity-claude", Type: "antigravity", HasThinking: true, Min: 1024, Max: 64000, MaxCompl: 8192},
		{ID: "s-codex", Type: "codex", HasThinking: true, Levels: []string{"low", "medium", "high", "xhigh"}},
		{ID: "s-codex-cfg", Type: "codex", HasThinking: true, CfgUpdate: true, Levels: []string{"low", "medium", "high", "xhigh"}},
		{ID: "s-codex-nothinking-cfg", Type: "codex", CfgUpdate: true},
		{ID: "s-xai", Type: "xai", HasThinking: true, Zero: true, Levels: []string{"none", "low", "high"}},
		{ID: "s-kimi", Type: "kimi", HasThinking: true, Levels: []string{"low", "medium", "high"}},
		{ID: "s-none", Type: "openai"},
		{ID: "s-user", Type: "openai", UserDefined: true},
		{ID: "s-user-cfg", Type: "codex", UserDefined: true, CfgUpdate: true},
		{ID: "s-compat", Type: "openai-compatibility", HasThinking: true, Levels: []string{"high", "xhigh"}},
		{ID: "s-interactions", Type: "gemini", HasThinking: true, Levels: []string{"Low", "HIGH"}},
	}
	toForTypes := []string{"claude", "openai", "codex", "gemini", "antigravity", "kimi", "xai", "interactions", "openai-response"}
	m2 := 0
	for _, sp := range specs {
		for _, to := range toForTypes {
			for bi, body := range wideBodies {
				key := fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%d|info", sp.ID, to, bi)
				for variant := 0; variant < 2; variant++ {
					from := wideFrom[pick(len(wideFrom), key, "from", fmt.Sprint(variant))]
					srcIdx := pick(len(wideBodies), key, "src", fmt.Sprint(variant))
					source := wideBodies[srcIdx]
					if variant == 0 && pick(4, key, "nosrc") == 0 {
						source = ""
					}
					suffix := wideSuffixes[pick(len(wideSuffixes), key, "suffix", fmt.Sprint(variant))]
					normalized := pick(5, key, "norm", fmt.Sprint(variant)) == 0
					var mi *registry.ModelInfo
					nilInfo := sp.ID == "s-user" && pick(3, key, "nil") == 0
					if !nilInfo {
						mi = &registry.ModelInfo{ID: sp.ID, Type: sp.Type, MaxCompletionTokens: sp.MaxCompl, SupportConfigurationUpdate: sp.CfgUpdate, UserDefined: sp.UserDefined}
						if sp.HasThinking {
							mi.Thinking = &registry.ThinkingSupport{Min: sp.Min, Max: sp.Max, ZeroAllowed: sp.Zero, DynamicAllowed: sp.Dyn, Levels: sp.Levels}
						}
					}
					m := sp.ID + suffix
					providerKey := to
					if sp.Type == "openai-compatibility" && pick(2, key, "pk") == 0 {
						providerKey = "openrouter"
					}
					var summary thinking.SummaryConfig
					useExplicit := pick(3, key, "explicit") == 0
					if useExplicit {
						summary = thinking.ExtractSummaryConfig([]byte(source), from)
					}
					var out []byte
					var err error
					if useExplicit {
						out, err = thinking.ApplyThinkingWithModelInfoAndSummary([]byte(body), []byte(source), m, from, to, providerKey, mi, summary, normalized)
					} else {
						out, err = thinking.ApplyThinkingWithModelInfo([]byte(body), []byte(source), m, from, to, providerKey, mi)
					}
					r := rec{"kind": "applyInfo", "model": m, "from": from, "to": to, "providerKey": providerKey, "input": body, "source": source,
						"explicitSummary": useExplicit, "summaryMode": int(summary.Mode), "summaryDetail": summary.Detail, "normalized": normalized,
						"output": string(out), "err": err != nil}
					if mi == nil {
						r["info"] = nil
					} else {
						r["info"] = map[string]any{"id": sp.ID, "type": sp.Type, "hasThinking": sp.HasThinking, "min": sp.Min, "max": sp.Max, "zero": sp.Zero,
							"dyn": sp.Dyn, "levels": sp.Levels, "maxCompl": sp.MaxCompl, "cfgUpdate": sp.CfgUpdate, "userDefined": sp.UserDefined}
					}
					if err != nil {
						r["errMsg"] = err.Error()
					}
					emit(r)
					m2++
				}
			}
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("applyInfo records", m2)

	// kind=summary: extraction, application and effort labels.
	formats := []string{"openai", "openai-response", "codex", "claude", "gemini", "antigravity", "interactions", "kimi", "bogus", " OpenAI "}
	summaryModels := []string{"", "claude-opus-5", "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", "claude-sonnet-4-6(high)", "unknown-claude", "gemini-3.6-flash"}
	m3 := 0
	for _, body := range wideBodies {
		for _, format := range formats {
			c := thinking.ExtractSummaryConfig([]byte(body), format)
			e := thinking.ExtractExplicitSummaryConfig([]byte(body), format)
			tr := thinking.ExtractTranslatedSummaryConfig([]byte(body), format, "claude")
			emit(rec{"kind": "summaryExtract", "input": body, "format": format,
				"mode": int(c.Mode), "detail": c.Detail, "explicitMode": int(e.Mode), "explicitDetail": e.Detail,
				"translatedMode": int(tr.Mode), "translatedDetail": tr.Detail})
			m3++
			for _, model := range summaryModels {
				for mode := 1; mode <= 2; mode++ {
					for _, detail := range []string{"", "concise", "detailed", "weird"} {
						if mode == 2 && detail != "" {
							continue
						}
						cfg := thinking.SummaryConfig{Mode: thinking.SummaryMode(mode), Detail: detail}
						out := thinking.ApplySummaryConfigForModel([]byte(body), format, model, cfg)
						emit(rec{"kind": "summaryApply", "input": body, "format": format, "model": model, "mode": mode, "detail": detail, "output": string(out)})
						m3++
					}
				}
			}
			out := thinking.ApplyTranslatedSummaryToClaude([]byte(`{"max_tokens":32000}`), []byte(body), format, "claude-opus-5")
			emit(rec{"kind": "summaryToClaude", "source": body, "format": format, "output": string(out)})
			for _, model := range append(summaryModels, "gpt-6-astra(high)", "m(none)", "m(auto)", "m(512)", "m(xyz)") {
				emit(rec{"kind": "effort", "input": body, "provider": format, "model": model,
					"effort": thinking.ExtractReasoningEffort([]byte(body), format, model),
					"translated": thinking.ExtractTranslatedReasoningEffort([]byte(body), format)})
				m3++
			}
			emit(rec{"kind": "strip", "input": body, "provider": format, "output": string(thinking.StripThinkingConfig([]byte(body), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(format))))})
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("summary records", m3)

	// kind=validate: direct ValidateConfig table.
	cfgs := []thinking.ThinkingConfig{
		{Mode: thinking.ModeBudget, Budget: 1}, {Mode: thinking.ModeBudget, Budget: 500}, {Mode: thinking.ModeBudget, Budget: 8192},
		{Mode: thinking.ModeBudget, Budget: 64000}, {Mode: thinking.ModeBudget, Budget: 300000}, {Mode: thinking.ModeBudget, Budget: -5},
		{Mode: thinking.ModeBudget, Budget: 0}, {Mode: thinking.ModeNone}, {Mode: thinking.ModeNone, Level: "low"}, {Mode: thinking.ModeNone, Budget: 7},
		{Mode: thinking.ModeAuto, Budget: -1}, {Mode: thinking.ModeLevel, Level: "none"}, {Mode: thinking.ModeLevel, Level: "auto"},
		{Mode: thinking.ModeLevel, Level: "minimal"}, {Mode: thinking.ModeLevel, Level: "high"}, {Mode: thinking.ModeLevel, Level: "HIGH"},
		{Mode: thinking.ModeLevel, Level: "xhigh"}, {Mode: thinking.ModeLevel, Level: "max"}, {Mode: thinking.ModeLevel, Level: "ultra"}, {Mode: thinking.ModeLevel, Level: ""},
	}
	allSpecs := specs
	m4 := 0
	for _, sp := range allSpecs {
		for _, from := range []string{"openai", "claude", "gemini", "codex", "antigravity", "", "interactions"} {
			for _, to := range []string{"openai", "claude", "gemini", "codex", "antigravity", "kimi", "xai"} {
				for ci, c := range cfgs {
					for _, suffix := range []bool{false, true} {
						var mi *registry.ModelInfo
						mi = &registry.ModelInfo{ID: sp.ID, Type: sp.Type, UserDefined: sp.UserDefined}
						if sp.HasThinking {
							mi.Thinking = &registry.ThinkingSupport{Min: sp.Min, Max: sp.Max, ZeroAllowed: sp.Zero, DynamicAllowed: sp.Dyn, Levels: sp.Levels}
						}
						_ = ci
						res, err := thinking.ValidateConfig(c, mi, from, to, suffix)
						r := rec{"kind": "validate", "spec": sp.ID, "from": from, "to": to, "fromSuffix": suffix,
							"mode": int(c.Mode), "budget": c.Budget, "level": string(c.Level),
							"info": map[string]any{"id": sp.ID, "type": sp.Type, "hasThinking": sp.HasThinking, "min": sp.Min, "max": sp.Max, "zero": sp.Zero,
								"dyn": sp.Dyn, "levels": sp.Levels, "maxCompl": sp.MaxCompl, "cfgUpdate": sp.CfgUpdate, "userDefined": sp.UserDefined},
							"err": err != nil}
						if err != nil {
							r["errMsg"] = err.Error()
						} else {
							r["outMode"] = int(res.Mode)
							r["outBudget"] = res.Budget
							r["outLevel"] = string(res.Level)
						}
						emit(r)
						m4++
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("validate records", m4)
}
